references.text: The same instruction to make carrying poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, here for the table of showbread.
Carrying poles of acacia wood for the altar of burnt offering, but these were overlaid with bronze instead of gold.
Carrying poles of acacia wood overlaid with gold for the altar of incense, following the same construction pattern.
Fulfillment of the command: Bezalel made the carrying poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold for the ark.
Bezalel also made carrying poles of acacia wood overlaid with gold for the table.
Carrying poles of acacia wood overlaid with gold were made for the altar of incense.
Instructions on inserting the carrying poles when the ark was to be transported by the Levites.
The carrying poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place in front of the Most Holy Place in Solomon's temple.
